items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: first Benny comes over to me after I’d played a few numbers with the band, and he says, “okay, kid, you got the job.”

ctx.x: No symbols. It had real chords, like charts with chords. So when I sat down I just blacked out. I looked at that and I said forget it, it’s not going to happen. But since I had such a good ear from the time I was like six years old or whatever, or from birth, the band started to play and I played along with them. Now I found out later — first Benny comes over to me after I’d played a few numbers with the band, and he says, “okay, kid, you got the job.” And I’m saying why would this guy hire me? I mean I couldn’t…
